question.prompt: Each third-grade classroom at Pearl Creek Elementary has \(18\) students and \(2\) pet rabbits. How many more students than rabbits are there in all \(4\) of the third-grade classrooms?

solutions.explanation:
Each classroom has \(18-2=16\) more students than rabbits. There are four classrooms, each with this same difference, so altogether there are
\[
4(18-2)=4\cdot16=\boxed{64}
\]
more students than rabbits, choice \(\mathrm{C}\).
solutions.title: Multiply the difference in one classroom
